risk_description: Data consistency failure during offline-sync reconciliation between local Isar NoSQL database and backend Aurora PostgreSQL due to schema evolution mismatches or 'Last Write Wins' race conditions.
root_cause: Complexity of mapping local NoSQL documents to relational SQL tables combined with concurrent offline mutations and lack of advanced conflict resolution logic.
mitigation_strategy: Implement rigorous schema versioning on client-side Isar DB with automated migration scripts. Enhance 'Last Write Wins' with server-side validation timestamps. Develop automated integration tests using network link conditioners to simulate edge case sync scenarios.
contingency_plan: Implement a 'Force Full Resync' mechanism in the mobile client to discard local corruption and re-fetch the truth from the server.
monitoring_trigger: Sync error rate exceeding 1% in client telemetry or detection of orphan records in the backend database.

risk_description: Cost overrun for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless and OpenAI API usage due to unoptimized vector embedding generation or excessive user prompts without rate limiting.
affected_tasks: WI-AI-001 (User Context Embedding Job), WI-AI-002 (Recommendation Service)
root_cause: OpenSearch Serverless has a minimum OCU (OpenSearch Compute Unit) cost regardless of traffic, and LLM pricing is token-based.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict rate limiting on the Recommendation endpoint. Batch embedding updates via Hangfire jobs rather than real-time. Configure AWS Budgets and Cost Anomaly Detection alerts specifically for OpenSearch.
contingency_plan: Fallback to a simpler, SQL-based recommendation algorithm (e.g., genre matching) and disable vector search if budget thresholds are breached.
monitoring_trigger: Daily AWS cost for OpenSearch exceeding $20 or OpenAI token usage spiking by >50% week-over-week.

risk_description: Revenue loss and premium user churn caused by failures in processing In-App Purchase (IAP) webhooks from Apple/Google due to downtime or payload validation errors.
root_cause: Dependency on asynchronous, third-party server-to-server notifications which may be delayed, out-of-order, or malformed.
mitigation_strategy: Implement robust idempotency checks in the Webhook Controller. Utilize Amazon SQS DLQ (Dead Letter Queue) to capture and retry failed webhook processing. Implement a client-side receipt validation fallback.
contingency_plan: Manual support workflow to provision Premium entitlements based on user-provided purchase receipts while investigating webhook failures.
monitoring_trigger: Increase in failed webhook transactions or SQS DLQ depth > 0.

risk_description: Dashboard interaction latency exceeding the 1.5s (4G) requirement due to heavy initialization of Flutter Riverpod providers and simultaneous hydration of Isar local data.
root_cause: Main thread blocking during heavy JSON parsing or Isar query execution on app startup.
mitigation_strategy: Offload heavy database I/O and JSON parsing to Flutter Isolates. Use lazy loading for Riverpod providers. Implement skeleton screens (shimmer effects) to improve perceived performance.
contingency_plan: Simplify dashboard data requirements for initial load and fetch secondary data (e.g., reading statistics) asynchronously.
monitoring_trigger: Firebase Performance Monitoring reporting 'App Start' trace duration > 2s on median devices.

risk_description: Non-compliance with GDPR 'Right to Erasure' due to failure in orchestrating hard-deletes across distributed data stores (Aurora, OpenSearch, S3 Audit Logs).
root_cause: Data is fragmented across relational DB, vector DB, and immutable logs; S3 Object Lock prevents modification of audit logs.
mitigation_strategy: Design the system to store PII *only* in the primary Aurora DB and reference it via GUIDs elsewhere. Ensure S3 audit logs record actions by GUID, not email/name, to avoid need for log modification.
contingency_plan: Manual script execution to scrubbing PII from backups and secondary stores if automated deletion fails.
monitoring_trigger: Audit alerts indicating failed 'UserDeletedEvent' propagation to OpenSearch or Backup subsystems.

risk_description: Google Books API quality issues (missing covers, ISBN mismatches) degrading the user library experience.
root_cause: Reliance on a free, public API with known data quality inconsistencies and rate limits.
mitigation_strategy: Implement a proxy/caching layer to sanitize and store book metadata locally after the first fetch. Allow users to manually edit book metadata and upload custom covers.
contingency_plan: Switch to Open Library API or a paid provider (e.g., ISBNdb) if Google Books reliability becomes a critical blocker.
monitoring_trigger: User support tickets regarding 'missing book covers' or 'incorrect book details' exceeding 5% of total volume.
